title: Glass bowls with bamboo lids
text: Glass bowls with bamboo lids. These are great glass rectangle bowls with bamboo lids - they have silicone rims so they seal nicely.  I love them. Hold about 2 cups? Wash glass bottoms go in the dishwasher, I hand wash the bamboo lids.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. All of my reviews reflect my honest, personal experience with the reviewed item - your experience may be different. I am not influenced by any outside source. I receive/accept NO free products or discounts that are not available to all shoppers- ever. product_metadata.title: Glass Food Storage Containers with Bamboo Lids (4 Pack, 36 Ounce) Eco Friendly Meal Prep Containers Airtight – Plastic Free, BPA Free
features: ✅ MEETS YOUR STORAGE NEEDS - Made of borosilicate, the strongest glass available, our kitchen ware can withstand temperatures of up to 520°F. They are freezer, microwave, oven, and dishwasher-safe (Not the lids).
✅ ECO-CONSCIOUS MATERIALS - Our containers are absolutely plastic-free. We make sure all the materials we use are kind to nature--from the box down to the silicone seal that keeps our lids airtight!

✅ DUAL-PURPOSE BAMBOO LID - Get 4 x 36oz containers sized 7.75 x 5.75 x 2.3 inches. The beautiful tight-fitting bamboo lids also function as cutting boards, while the leakproof cover ensures no spills.
✅ WE CARE ABOUT YOUR HEALTH - No need to worry about food, odor, or irritants seeping into these nonporous 36oz glass containers. Designed to safeguard your health, they are non-toxic and BPA-free.

✅ SAFETY & ENVIRONMENTAL STEWARDSHIP - We are committed to delivering a food container that share and reflect your passion for food safety and the environment. You get full warranty--no questions asked!
